tips.advancedSettings.text.defaultMessage: After a coding agent's update, Hive no longer sees its trust question or its sign-in errors? Settings → Advanced has the text and fields Hive looks for, and its timeouts: change one, with the default beside it, or edit advanced.json.
tips.advancedSettings.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.agentConsole.text.defaultMessage: Settings → Agent API → Let agents read the developer console gives agents a read-only tool showing their CLI's hooks and status line next to what Hive made of each, redacted, so they can debug what Hive sees.
tips.agentConsole.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.agentConsole.title.defaultMessage: Let agents see what their CLI sends

tips.agentInSlot.text.defaultMessage: Beside an agent's name on its pane: in slot-b while it builds a card in a slot (click it for Branches & remotes), carried: hb2 in the slot kept for it, home: hr4 for a reviewer's retired home. The project's hover lists them in a Slot column.
tips.agentInSlot.text.description: A tip. A slot is a working folder (a worktree) Hive lends to a card or a lane; in slot-b, carried: hb2 and home: hr4 are examples of agents.place.short, as Hive shows them. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them. Glossary: slot.

tips.agentLayouts.text.defaultMessage: Each agent has its own pane: choose a layout at the right of the session toolbar, and drag a pane by its header to rearrange them. File locks stop two agents editing the same file.
tips.agentLayouts.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.agentMenu.text.defaultMessage: An agent's pane header keeps to its state, its card and Stop. Compact, Hand Over, Merge…, its settings and anything that needs a look (a dot on ⋯ says so) are in its ⋯ menu, or right-click the header. {key}
tips.agentMenu.text.description: A tip. {key} is a shortcut (its keys, or the command's name when it has none). ⋯ is the button on an agent's pane header: keep it. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.agentMenu.title.defaultMessage: Everything else is under an agent's ⋯
tips.agentMenu.title.description: A tip's title. ⋯ is the button on an agent's pane header: keep it.

tips.agentSettings.text.defaultMessage: Click an agent's model in its footer for Agent Settings: give a reviewer a faster model while another agent codes with the strongest.
tips.agentSettings.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.agentStates.text.defaultMessage: Each agent has one of four states, told apart by shape as well as colour: a diamond waits for you, a square is stalled, a pulsing dot is working and a ring is idle. The project header counts them: "1 waiting · 2 working".
tips.agentStates.text.description: A tip. The four shapes are the marks Hive draws for an agent's state; keep the example's wording as the header's state line translates it.

tips.agentStates.title.defaultMessage: Read your agents at a glance

tips.agentWorkflowRole.text.defaultMessage: Each agent's Role in the workflow, in Agent Settings, says whether it builds cards, reviews them, or either. Start Lane offers builders and reviewers by it.
tips.agentWorkflowRole.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them. Glossary: workflow role.

tips.agentWorkflowRole.title.description: A tip's title. Glossary: builder, reviewer.

tips.allKeysToCli.text.defaultMessage: In an agent's pane, Hive's shortcuts take their keys. Turn on Settings → Advanced → All keys go to the CLI to send every key to the CLI instead, but the command palette's (Show All Commands), so every command is still in reach.
tips.allKeysToCli.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.allKeysToCli.title.defaultMessage: Give every key to the agent's CLI

tips.alwaysOnTop.text.defaultMessage: The pin in the title bar (or Ctrl+Alt+O) keeps the window above your other apps, so a test run or an emulator can work underneath. Each window has its own, remembered for its workspace.
tips.alwaysOnTop.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.alwaysOnTop.title.defaultMessage: Keep a Hive window on top

tips.antivirus.text.defaultMessage: On Windows, Microsoft Defender scans every file builds, tests and git touch. Settings → Workspace → Antivirus scanning shows whether it scans your workspace and can exclude its folders, with your consent.
tips.antivirus.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.archiveNew.text.defaultMessage: The cheapest way to carry on after a long session: archive it and start clean, so nothing old is re-cached. Write a handover first so the new one knows where to pick up.
tips.archiveNew.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.assistant.text.defaultMessage: The panel on the right oversees the workspace: ask what the agents are doing, what things cost, or for a plan. {key}
tips.assistant.text.description: A tip. {key} is a shortcut (its keys, or the command's name when it has none). Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.assistantBatch.text.defaultMessage: The Assistant can move or label up to {cards, plural, one {# card} other {# cards}} in one step, each card still listed on its own.
tips.assistantBatch.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them. {cards} is how many cards one step can change (100).

tips.assistantCompact.text.defaultMessage: The Assistant usually works with a bigger context than your agents, so its Compact button turns orange later: past {tokens, plural, one {# token} other {# tokens}} by default. Settings → Assistant → Highlight Compact over changes that, or Never turns it off.
tips.assistantCompact.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them. {tokens} is the default (500,000).

tips.assistantControl.text.defaultMessage: Settings → Assistant → Control decides what it may do: only advise, or also add, start and brief agents and start cards when you ask.
tips.assistantControl.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.assistantImages.text.defaultMessage: The Assistant view's Attachments shows every screenshot and file you've pasted or dropped into its conversations, by conversation. Click a conversation's name to read it again.
tips.assistantImages.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.assistantImages.title.defaultMessage: What you've attached to the Assistant

tips.assistantJournal.text.defaultMessage: The Assistant keeps a journal in each workspace: decisions, plans and what happened, recalled a few lines at a time after a restart. Settings → Assistant → Journal chooses what it may store, or turns it off.
tips.assistantJournal.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.assistantJournalBrowser.text.defaultMessage: The Assistant view's Journal shows what the Assistant keeps in its journal, newest first. Search it, open an entry to correct or delete it, or use Forget These… to remove everything a search finds.
tips.assistantJournalBrowser.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.assistantLaneWatch.text.defaultMessage: Running several lanes, the Assistant waits on all of them at once and is woken only for a failed review, a blocked or stalled card, a lane ready to merge or one that ended.
tips.assistantLaneWatch.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.assistantLaneWatch.title.defaultMessage: One watch for all the lanes

tips.assistantLanes.text.defaultMessage: When the Assistant starts an agent on its next set of cards, it gives it a new conversation in the same step (the old one stays in the Sessions tab). Short conversations cost much less: ask it to do the same for any new card.
tips.assistantLanes.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.assistantLanes.title.defaultMessage: A new conversation for each lane

tips.assistantMessages.text.defaultMessage: The Assistant can't give a waiting or working agent a new task, but it can leave it a message, such as your answer: delivered as soon as the agent can take it. Its pane shows it as unread (✉) until then; click that to cancel it.
tips.assistantMessages.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.assistantMessages.title.defaultMessage: The Assistant can reach a busy agent

tips.assistantReplies.text.defaultMessage: When you answer an agent in its pane while the Assistant watches it or its card, the Assistant is told the first line, so it doesn't ask you again. Settings → General → Your name sets how it names you; Settings → Assistant turns it off.
tips.assistantReplies.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.assistantReplies.title.defaultMessage: The Assistant hears your answers to agents

tips.assistantSettings.text.defaultMessage: Not sure which setting would help? Ask the Assistant: it explains any of them and says where it is. With Settings → Assistant → Control → Change settings on, it can make the change, which you can revert from its panel.
tips.assistantSettings.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.assistantSettings.title.defaultMessage: Ask the Assistant about a setting

tips.assistantSide.text.defaultMessage: Windows notifications or another app covering the right of the screen? View → Move Assistant Panel to the Left puts the Assistant beside the project list.
tips.assistantSide.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.assistantStatus.text.defaultMessage: The line under the Assistant's header says what it is doing, and which cards it waits on and until when: click one to open it. Done by the Assistant at its end lists what it did. Under Workspace, hover an agent's mark for what it's doing; click to go there.
tips.assistantStatus.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.assistantTeam.text.defaultMessage: With three or more agents, or builders and reviewers, ask the Assistant in Coordinator mode to run your cards as lanes: it splits them by the files they touch, briefs each pair and watches every lane to the end. With one or two agents it keeps out of the way.
tips.assistantTeam.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.assistantToldWaiting.text.defaultMessage: While the Assistant watches the lanes, an agent showing a permission prompt or asking you something wakes it, and it tells you which agent, its card and what it asks. It never answers for you. Its watch can follow a release card outside the lanes too.
tips.assistantToldWaiting.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.assistantToldWaiting.title.defaultMessage: The Assistant tells you when an agent needs you

tips.assistantUndo.text.defaultMessage: Done by the Assistant lists its changes by your message. Undo on a change puts it back, and Undo on a message puts back all of them; whatever you or an agent changed since is kept.
tips.assistantUndo.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them. Glossary: undo, changed since.

tips.assistantWaits.text.defaultMessage: Ask the Assistant to let you know when an agent finishes a build or a test run: it waits without checking in, and Hive wakes it when the agent finishes, needs you or stops.
tips.assistantWaits.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.assistantWaits.title.defaultMessage: Have the Assistant tell you when an agent is done

tips.attachFiles.text.defaultMessage: Drop a PDF, a log or any file onto an agent's terminal: Hive keeps a copy with the session and pastes its path. A chip shows what's attached, and says when the agent's CLI doesn't read that kind of file itself, so the agent opens it by its path.
tips.attachFiles.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.attachFiles.title.defaultMessage: Attach any file to a prompt

tips.backupRetention.text.defaultMessage: Hive compresses its transcript backups once a session ends, and Storage shows what they hold. To let old ones go, set Settings → Sessions → Keep transcript backups: only copies of sessions the CLI still has go to the Recycle Bin.
tips.backupRetention.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.backupRetention.title.defaultMessage: Backups take less room, and can expire

tips.banners.text.defaultMessage: While you use Hive, an agent finishing or needing you is a banner in the window, not a Windows notification over the Assistant. Settings → Notifications chooses where it shows, for which workspaces, and for how long.
tips.banners.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.banners.title.defaultMessage: Notices in Hive, not over it

tips.board.text.defaultMessage: Cards in On Hold, Todo, Active, Review, Approved and Done, each for a project. Start… gives a card to an agent with the card as its prompt. {key}
tips.board.text.description: A tip. {key} is a shortcut (its keys, or the command's name when it has none). Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.board.title.defaultMessage: Plan work on the task board

tips.boardArchive.text.defaultMessage: Tick Archived on the board for a table of archived cards: sort and filter them by project, label or the column they came from, and Unarchive one or a whole selection.
tips.boardArchive.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.boardArchiveAll.text.defaultMessage: A column's ⋯ has Archive All in Done (n)…, and the board's ⋯ has Archive All Cards… for every column. Cards agents are on are skipped unless you say, and Undo puts everything back where it was.
tips.boardArchiveAll.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.boardArchiveAll.title.defaultMessage: Clear a column in one go

tips.boardDoing.text.defaultMessage: Drag a card into Active and Hive asks: nobody yet, an agent without starting anything, or an agent that starts on it now.
tips.boardDoing.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.boardDoing.title.defaultMessage: Choose who works on a card in Active

tips.boardDone.text.defaultMessage: A reviewer moves a card that passes its review to Approved; Done means merged, and an agent moves its cards there after merging its work. Say "merged, move #65 to done" and it does; the card's history shows who moved it.
tips.boardDone.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.boardExport.text.defaultMessage: The board is kept in the workspace's database. Export Board to JSON… in the board's ⋯ menu saves every card as a JSON file, archived ones too, in a folder you choose.
tips.boardExport.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.boardFold.text.defaultMessage: Collapse a column to a narrow strip with the « in its header, and fold cards to one line with their ▾; a column's ⋯ collapses or expands all its cards. Hive remembers them for the workspace.
tips.boardFold.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.boardFold.title.defaultMessage: Fold the board to what matters

tips.boardHygiene.text.defaultMessage: Ask the Assistant to tidy the board: it links duplicate cards for you to archive, records your answers as decisions on their cards, and raises blocked reasons that are out of date.
tips.boardHygiene.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them. Decisions are what the user decided about a card, as the card shows them.

tips.boardHygiene.title.defaultMessage: Ask the Assistant to tidy the board

tips.boardOrder.text.defaultMessage: Drag the most important cards to the top, or ask the Assistant or an agent to prioritise: they reorder the board itself.
tips.boardOrder.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.boardOrder.title.defaultMessage: A column's order is its priority

tips.boardReview.text.defaultMessage: Say "review #87" to another agent: the card stays in Review with the agent that did the work, shows who is reviewing it, and gets the verdict as a comment. When it passes, the reviewer moves it to Approved.
tips.boardReview.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.boardReview.title.defaultMessage: Have an agent review a card

tips.boardSetAside.text.defaultMessage: Opened in an older Hive, a workspace gets its cards set aside when this one opens it again. Review… on the notice, or Set-Aside Cards… in the board's ⋯ menu, adds each to the board or discards it.
tips.boardSetAside.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.boardSetAside.title.defaultMessage: Cards made by an older Hive

tips.boardStages.text.defaultMessage: The board’s columns are the stages your workflow options make: Merging sits under Approved while Hive merges, and a stage nobody uses is hidden. Ask the Assistant to rename one, such as “call Active Building in web”: a name changes no rule.
tips.boardStages.text.description: A tip (glossary 2.2: stage). Active is a board column: use its name as the board shows it. The quoted request is what the user would ask the Assistant: translate it.

tips.boardStages.title.defaultMessage: The board shows your workflow’s stages

tips.boardUpgrade.text.defaultMessage: Hive keeps the 0.9 board it upgraded to 1.0. Help → Restore the 0.9 Board Backup… puts it back, after keeping a copy of the board as it is, so a 0.9 Hive can change it again.
tips.boardUpgrade.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.branchCards.text.defaultMessage: In Version Control → Branches & remotes, a branch a card works on shows the card and its stage, and in Review the revision under review. Click the card to open it.
tips.branchCards.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them (glossary 2.1: Version Control; 2.2: stage).

tips.branchCards.title.defaultMessage: See which card a branch is for

tips.cardCost.text.defaultMessage: A card's panel says what its agents used while they held it, "{example}", with the builder's and reviewer's parts and tokens on hover. Performance lists every card's cost, and a lane's hover in the Progress panel its overhead.
tips.cardCost.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them. {example} is a card's cost line as the board shows it ("cost: ≈ $1.84 · 2 rounds").

tips.cardDecisions.text.defaultMessage: A card's Decisions, above its comments, hold what you decided: agents check their work against them before Review, and reviewers fail work that ignores one. Tell the Assistant a decision and it records it there; an agent waiting for your answer is told.
tips.cardDecisions.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.cardDecisions.title.defaultMessage: Put what you decide on the card

tips.cardLinks.text.defaultMessage: Card numbers an agent or the Assistant prints, like #12, are links: hover one for its title and column, and Ctrl+click it to open the card.
tips.cardLinks.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.cardLinks.title.defaultMessage: Ctrl+click a card number in the terminal

tips.cardLoop.text.defaultMessage: Tell one agent to work through some cards as the builder and another to review them: each waits for the other at no cost, and Hive wakes it when the card changes.
tips.cardLoop.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.cardLoop.title.defaultMessage: Let two agents build and review in turn

tips.cardMove.text.defaultMessage: Drag any dialog by its header (a card, Add Agent, Agent Settings…) to see what's behind it; Escape while dragging puts it back.
tips.cardMove.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.cardMove.title.defaultMessage: Move a dialog out of the way

tips.cardReadFirst.text.defaultMessage: In a card's Read first, list the doc sections it needs, like docs/PLAN.md#setup: the agent's start prompt lists them, so it reads those sections instead of a whole plan. Click one to read it in Hive.
tips.cardReadFirst.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them. Keep docs/PLAN.md#setup as it is.

tips.cardReadFirst.title.defaultMessage: Point a card at the docs it needs

tips.cardSummaries.text.defaultMessage: Agents start a card's report or review verdict with one line saying what is ready or what was found, the details below; they and the Assistant read just those lines when that's enough.
tips.cardSummaries.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.cardWork.text.defaultMessage: Open a card: its Work section lists each revision submitted for review, with its round, files, verdicts and checks, and how it was merged. On the board, a card shows its revision and last verdict.
tips.cardWork.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands (Work): keep them as Hive shows them. Glossary: work, revision, verdict, check.

tips.cardWork.title.defaultMessage: See what a card’s work went through
tips.cardWork.title.description: A tip's title. Glossary: work (a card's Work section).

tips.claudeStatusLine.text.defaultMessage: Hive's status line feeds an agent's footer and shows nothing in the pane. Turn off Settings → Advanced → Hive's status line in place of yours to see the one in your Claude Code settings again: Hive still reads the status.
tips.claudeStatusLine.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.claudeStatusLine.title.defaultMessage: Keep your own Claude Code status line
tips.claudeStatusLine.title.description: A tip's title. The status line is the line Claude Code shows under its input.

tips.cliOverrides.text.defaultMessage: Hive changes a little of how each CLI behaves in its sessions, such as Copilot not updating itself or Codex's terminal title. Each change can be turned off in Settings → Advanced, under its CLI, which says what Hive can no longer do without it.
tips.cliOverrides.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.cliOverrides.title.defaultMessage: Keep a CLI as it is outside Hive

tips.cliOwnMode.text.defaultMessage: Choose The CLI's own setting as an agent's or a project's permission mode and Hive passes none: the CLI starts in the mode its own config sets. The badge says CLI's own, and switching a running session restarts it.
tips.cliOwnMode.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.cliOwnMode.title.defaultMessage: Let the CLI's own config choose the mode

tips.closeWindow.text.defaultMessage: With several windows open, File → Close Window ({key}) closes just this one, as its X does. Exit Hive (all windows) closes every window and stops all their agents.
tips.closeWindow.text.description: A tip. {key} is a shortcut (its keys, or the command's name when it has none). Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.closeWindow.title.defaultMessage: Close one window, or all of them

tips.commandName.description: A command's name in a tip's text, where its shortcut would be when it has none. Use your language's quotation marks.

tips.compactFocus.text.defaultMessage: Compact summarises the conversation so every later message costs less. Give it a focus ("keep the API decisions, drop the test output") and the agent keeps what matters. {key}
tips.compactFocus.text.description: A tip. {key} is a shortcut (its keys, or the command's name when it has none). Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.compactSidebar.text.defaultMessage: Toggle Compact Sidebar turns the project list into a narrow rail of tiles with each project's agents, leaving more room for the terminals.
tips.compactSidebar.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.compactionHistory.text.defaultMessage: The Overview's compaction history pages, filters and sorts a long session's compactions; click one to read it in the transcript, with the summary the agent carried on from.
tips.compactionHistory.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.compactionHistory.title.defaultMessage: Read a compaction where it happened

tips.consoleRecording.text.defaultMessage: In the developer console, Record writes what an agent's CLI sends Hive to a file, redacted unless you tick text for that recording, and Copy Diagnostics can attach it to a bug report.
tips.consoleRecording.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.consoleText.text.defaultMessage: Settings → Advanced → Developer console: show prompt, reply and command text shows them in the developer console, under a banner saying so, and ticks text for new recordings. Tokens and sign-ins stay masked, and agents' hive_console stays redacted.
tips.consoleText.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.consoleText.title.defaultMessage: See the text in the developer console

tips.copilot.text.defaultMessage: Agents can use the GitHub Copilot CLI, Copilot Free included. Agent Setup installs it and says who it is signed in as: its own login or the GitHub CLI’s.
tips.copilot.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.copilotModes.text.defaultMessage: Copilot agents start in Accept edits: they edit files in their own folder and use the hive tools without asking, and ask before other commands, other MCP tools and web access. Choose Ask to approve each edit too, or Allow all to approve everything.
tips.copilotModes.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.copyDiagnostics.text.defaultMessage: Help → Copy Diagnostics… gathers Hive's version, your coding agents, key settings and the end of the log for a bug report, with names, folders and tokens taken out.
tips.copyDiagnostics.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.ctrlCvToCli.text.defaultMessage: In an agent's pane Ctrl+C copies a selection and Ctrl+V pastes. Turn on Settings → Advanced → Ctrl+C and Ctrl+V go to the CLI to send both keys to the CLI instead, as in any other terminal; right-click still copies and pastes.
tips.ctrlCvToCli.text.description: A tip. Ctrl+C and Ctrl+V name keys: use the key names your language uses. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.ctrlCvToCli.title.defaultMessage: Give Ctrl+C and Ctrl+V to the agent's CLI
tips.ctrlCvToCli.title.description: A tip's title. Ctrl+C and Ctrl+V name keys: use the key names your language uses.

tips.dateFormat.text.defaultMessage: Hive shows dates as {date} and times as {time}. Settings → General → Date format and Time format change them everywhere, sessions named by when they started too.
tips.dateFormat.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them. {date} and {time} are an example date and time (4 October 2026, 14:05) in the formats chosen now.

tips.defaultProvider.text.defaultMessage: Default provider is Automatic unless you choose one: new agents use the first coding agent that is turned on and installed, so Codex or GitHub Copilot alone works without Claude Code. Choose one in Settings → Providers to always use it.
tips.defaultProvider.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.defaultProvider.title.defaultMessage: New agents use what you have installed

tips.designCheck.text.defaultMessage: Ask a card loop’s builder for a design first: it posts it on the card, Hive wakes the reviewer to check it, and the answer wakes the builder. With no answer within the Design check wait (Project Settings → Card loops), it goes ahead as posted.
tips.designCheck.text.description: A tip (#1382). Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them (Design check wait, Project Settings, Card loops).

tips.designCheck.title.defaultMessage: Have a design checked before the build
tips.designCheck.title.description: A tip's title (#1382). A design: the plan a builder posts on its card before building.

tips.developerConsole.text.defaultMessage: Turn on Settings → Advanced → Show developer features, then Help → Developer Console opens a window of its own: pick an agent and see each hook and status line beside what Hive made of it, redacted. Filter, search and pause as it runs.
tips.developerConsole.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.developerConsole.title.defaultMessage: Watch what a CLI sends Hive

tips.editTemplates.text.defaultMessage: Select a template in the Templates view and choose Edit…: add, copy, reorder or remove its agents, change each in the Agent Settings dialog (its Save saves the template too), rename it and pick its layout.
tips.editTemplates.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.fileLinks.text.defaultMessage: File paths an agent prints, like src/app.ts:42, are links: Ctrl+click one to open the file in the Files tab at that line.
tips.fileLinks.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.fileLinks.title.defaultMessage: Ctrl+click a path in the terminal

tips.filesTab.text.defaultMessage: The Files tab browses and edits the project, previews Markdown, CSV, HTML and images, and keeps unsaved edits as you switch.
tips.filesTab.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.flightRecorder.text.defaultMessage: Turn on a flight recorder trigger in Settings → Advanced (safeguard stops, something unknown from a CLI, a CLI version change, an agent gone silent), and Hive saves the agent's recent developer console events, redacted, the moment it happens, with a notice.
tips.flightRecorder.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.followUpCheck.text.defaultMessage: When you ask for a change to a card in Review or Approved for its reviewer to check, its builder posts the change as a follow-up: Hive wakes the reviewer, and the answer wakes the builder. One left unanswered for 15 minutes shows its card as stalled.
tips.followUpCheck.text.description: A tip (#1467). Review and Approved are board columns. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.followUpCheck.title.defaultMessage: Have a follow-up checked without a new round
tips.followUpCheck.title.description: A tip's title (#1467). A follow-up: a change asked of a card's reviewed work, such as a screenshot's, for its reviewer to check.

tips.forYou.text.defaultMessage: A card with a For you chip waits for you: an approval, a decision or a question. The Task Board icon counts them, and For you on the board shows only those. Open the card to approve, decline or answer: the agent waiting on it hears at once.
tips.forYou.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them. Glossary: For you, approve.

tips.forYouActions.text.defaultMessage: When an agent's question is about something only you can do on its card, it can offer it as a button under the question: Move to Done, Make It No Code or Unblock, with its suggested reason, which you can change. One click does it and answers the agent.
tips.forYouActions.text.description: A tip (#1630). Done is a board column. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them. Glossary: For you, no-code card.

tips.gitCheck.text.defaultMessage: Help → Agent Setup… shows the git Hive found and its version. Worktree agents, merging and the Version Control tab’s Git sections need Git for Windows 2.38 or later.
tips.gitCheck.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.gitInit.text.defaultMessage: A project without git? Its Version Control tab's Initialise repository… makes it one on main, keeps .hive out, adds a starter .gitignore if you like and makes the first commit, so agents can work in worktrees at once.
tips.gitInit.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.gitInit.title.defaultMessage: Make a project a git repository in one click

tips.gitRemotes.text.defaultMessage: Version Control → Branches & remotes: Push to… sends this branch, or every branch and tag, to any remote without changing what the branch tracks. A remote can be renamed or removed there, and a branch's Track… chooses what Pull and Push use.
tips.gitRemotes.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.gitView.text.defaultMessage: In a Git project, the Version Control tab shows its branch, remotes, history and tags, and lets you switch or create a branch, fetch, pull, push, tag and set its commit identity. The status bar shows "{example}": click it to get there.
tips.gitView.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them. {example} is the status bar's git item as Hive shows it ("main · origin · ↑2 ↓0": the branch, its remote, and how many commits it is ahead and behind).

tips.gitView.title.defaultMessage: See and change a project's git

tips.gotoProject.text.defaultMessage: Press {key} and type a few letters of its name.
tips.gotoProject.text.description: A tip. {key} is a shortcut (its keys, or the command's name when it has none). Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.group.agents.description: A heading of Help → Tips: tips about agents.

tips.group.assistant.description: A heading of Help → Tips: tips about the Hive Assistant.

tips.group.board.description: A heading of Help → Tips: tips about the task board.

tips.group.files.description: A heading of Help → Tips: tips about files and a project's git.

tips.group.sessions.description: A heading of Help → Tips: tips about sessions.

tips.group.shortcuts.description: A heading of Help → Tips: shortcuts and other ways to get around Hive.

tips.handoverSelf.text.defaultMessage: When an agent's transcript size turns amber, click it and choose the agent itself: it writes a handover, and a new conversation picks up from it, short and fast again.
tips.handoverSelf.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.handoverSelf.title.defaultMessage: A long conversation? Hand it over to itself

tips.hardwareAcceleration.text.defaultMessage: If your graphics driver leaves Hive's window blank, flickering or crashing, turn on Settings → Advanced → Disable hardware acceleration and restart Hive. A window that doesn't draw at all: start Hive once with --disable-gpu.
tips.hardwareAcceleration.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them. --disable-gpu is a command-line option: keep it.

tips.hiveFolder.text.defaultMessage: Hive keeps each project's .hive folder (sessions, backups, launch settings) out of git by itself. Where it can't, say with no git, another version control system, or a folder OneDrive or Dropbox syncs, the project's Overview tells you.
tips.hiveFolder.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.hiveFolder.title.defaultMessage: A project's .hive stays on this computer

tips.hiveMerges.text.defaultMessage: In Version Control → Workflow, choose Pair, or set Who merges to Hive merges: Hive’s merge queue merges each approved card once its checks pass on the merged result, so red work never reaches the target branch.
tips.hiveMerges.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them (glossary 2.1: merge queue).

tips.hiveSkills.text.defaultMessage: Agents and the Assistant get Hive's own skills: work-on-card, review-agent-work, handover and more. Hive keeps them up to date; ones you edit stay yours.
tips.hiveSkills.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.hooksMissing.text.defaultMessage: If a CLI update or a policy stops an agent’s hooks reaching Hive, its pane says Status unknown instead of a status that may be wrong, nothing is typed into it and its lane pauses. The banner over its pane says why when Hive can tell.
tips.hooksMissing.text.description: A tip. Hooks: the calls an agent's coding agent makes to Hive as it works. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.hooksMissing.title.defaultMessage: When an agent’s hooks stop arriving
tips.hooksMissing.title.description: A tip's title. Hooks: the calls an agent's coding agent makes to Hive as it works.

tips.howDoYouWork.text.defaultMessage: A new project’s Version Control tab asks “How do you work?”: Solo, Pair or Team, the one that fits its agents suggested. Choose sets it up in one click; Not Now keeps your defaults.
tips.howDoYouWork.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them (glossary 2.1: Version Control, preset). The quoted question is the step's heading: use it as Hive shows it.

tips.howDoYouWork.title.defaultMessage: Start a new project with a preset

tips.imagesTab.text.defaultMessage: The Attachments tab keeps each screenshot and file pasted or dropped into the project's sessions, grouped by session, with previews and a filter by kind, ready to insert again.
tips.imagesTab.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.imagesTab.title.defaultMessage: Everything you attached, in one place

tips.improveTranslation.text.defaultMessage: Spotted a clumsy or wrong word in your language? Help → Improve This Translation shows how to fix it, or add a language, with a pull request on GitHub.
tips.improveTranslation.text.description: A tip. Help → Improve This Translation is a name in Hive: keep it as Hive shows it. GitHub is a name.

tips.improveTranslation.title.defaultMessage: Make Hive read better in your language

tips.inboxCarryingOn.text.defaultMessage: Hive tells a working agent of new messages at a tool's end, keeps it going to read them before it stops, and wakes it when idle. Each has a switch in Settings → Advanced, and a project can set its own; with wakes off, the pane's Deliver Now types the line.
tips.inboxCarryingOn.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.inboxCarryingOn.title.defaultMessage: Choose how agents hear of their inbox

tips.inboxNotices.text.defaultMessage: A message the Assistant leaves a working agent reaches it at its next tool call, or before its turn ends, as a short notice from Hive: nothing is typed over its work. The agent reads it from its inbox and acks it; its pane shows it as unread (✉) until it does.
tips.inboxNotices.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.inboxNotices.title.defaultMessage: Messages reach a busy agent between steps

tips.isolatedChecks.text.defaultMessage: In a shared folder, another agent's edit during a check makes it not count. hive-progress --check typecheck --isolated runs it in a copy of its own at the card's revision, which nothing else writes. Stop in the Progress panel ends it and all it started.
tips.isolatedChecks.text.description: A tip. hive-progress --check typecheck --isolated is a command: keep it as it is. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.isolatedChecks.title.defaultMessage: A check nobody else can spoil

tips.keepAwake.text.defaultMessage: While an agent works, Hive stops Windows from sleeping (the screen can still lock), and lets it sleep once they're done. Choose when in Settings → General.
tips.keepAwake.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.keepAwake.title.defaultMessage: Leave agents working, the PC stays awake

tips.laneBranchSquash.text.defaultMessage: After an agent's card is squash-merged, Hive brings its branch up to date before its next card, so each review shows only that card's work. What it can't do safely it asks under For you; Settings → Advanced makes it ask every time.
tips.laneBranchSquash.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them. For you is the board's list of what waits for the user.

tips.laneBranchSquash.title.defaultMessage: An agent's branch kept up to date between cards
tips.laneBranchSquash.title.description: A tip's title. The branch is the one an agent builds on in its own worktree.

tips.laneGates.text.defaultMessage: In the Progress panel, a lane says why it waits in its header, and a red notch on a card’s segment means its last request was refused: hover it for why and what next.
tips.laneGates.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them. Glossary: lane, refused.

tips.laneGates.title.defaultMessage: See why a lane isn’t moving
tips.laneGates.title.description: A tip's title. A lane is Hive's record of a card loop (glossary 2.5: lane).

tips.laneNotices.text.defaultMessage: Hive notifies you when a lane's review fails, a card is blocked or stalls, or every card has passed so its merge is due, one notice per lane. Settings → Notifications decides where they appear.
tips.laneNotices.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.laneNotices.title.defaultMessage: Hear how a lane goes, without the Assistant
tips.laneNotices.title.description: A tip's title. A lane is Hive's record of a card loop (a builder and a reviewer taking cards in turn).

tips.laneSlots.text.defaultMessage: In the Progress panel, a lane names its slot after its agents (· slot-b): point at it for the branch being built there and whether the slot is ready, or click it for Branches & remotes.
tips.laneSlots.text.description: A tip. A slot is a working folder Hive lends to a lane (glossary 2.5: slot). Branches & remotes is a section of the Version Control tab: keep its name as Hive shows it.

tips.laneSlots.title.description: A tip's title. A lane is Hive's record of a card loop (glossary 2.5: lane).

tips.laneStart.text.defaultMessage: Right-click the Todo column and choose Start Lane with These Cards…: pick the builder and the reviewer, put the cards in order, and both start with a brief. End or abandon a lane from its row in the Progress panel.
tips.laneStart.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them. Glossary: lane.

tips.laneStart.title.description: A tip's title. A lane: a builder and a reviewer agent working through cards in turn (glossary 2.5: lane).

tips.lanesLegend.text.defaultMessage: Hover over the Lanes bar in the Progress panel for its legend: each colour is a category, with the stages in it. A lane marked old rules keeps the workflow options it started with until it ends.
tips.lanesLegend.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them. Glossary: lane, stage, category, workflow options.

tips.lanesLegend.title.description: A tip's title. A lane is Hive's record of a card loop (glossary 2.5: lane).

tips.language.text.defaultMessage: Hive follows Windows' display language when it has it. Settings → General → Language picks another; languages translated by AI are marked, and improvements are welcome. Agents are still spoken to in English.
tips.language.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.leftoverProcesses.text.defaultMessage: A preview server or a tail -f an agent started can keep running after it stops, holding the project's folder or a port. Hive lists them in the ⋯ menu on the agent's pane and offers to end them; Settings → Agents can end them every time.
tips.leftoverProcesses.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.leftoverProcesses.title.defaultMessage: End what a stopped agent left running

tips.licenceAudit.text.defaultMessage: Before a release, ask an agent to audit the licences of what your project ships. It reads them from the files, vendored material and installer parts included, and flags anything unclear for you.
tips.licenceAudit.text.description: A tip. Vendored material is other people's files a package carries inside it; installer parts are what the installer adds (its plug-ins and helpers).

tips.licenceAudit.title.defaultMessage: Audit the licences of what you ship

tips.loopDefaults.text.defaultMessage: Settings → Workspace → Card loop rounds and Card loop wait set what loops use when you don't say ({rounds, plural, one {# round} other {# rounds}} and {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}} to start with); a project can have its own. Saying "rounds: 3" when you start one still wins.
tips.loopDefaults.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them. {rounds} and {hours} are the defaults (10 and 6). "rounds: 3" is what the user types to an agent: keep it in English.

tips.loopDefaults.title.defaultMessage: Your rounds and wait for every loop

tips.loopLanes.text.defaultMessage: When two agents build and review cards in turn, Hive keeps the loop as a lane: its cards in order, the one it's on, and whether it's paused on a blocked card. Ask the Assistant which lanes are running.
tips.loopLanes.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.loopLanes.title.defaultMessage: Hive keeps your card loops as lanes

tips.loopWakes.text.defaultMessage: When a card arrives in Review, Hive wakes its reviewer, and on the verdict its builder, even if one forgot to wait. To drive reviews by hand, turn it off in the project's Settings → Card loops.
tips.loopWakes.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.loopWakes.title.defaultMessage: Loops keep going on their own

tips.mcpFromFile.text.defaultMessage: Got a server as a .json definition or a .zip of its folder? Add MCP Server from File in the MCP view shows what it runs and adds it turned off: switch it on there to choose its projects.
tips.mcpFromFile.text.description: A tip. Add MCP Server from File and the MCP view are names in Hive: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.mcpFromFile.title.defaultMessage: Add an MCP server from a file

tips.mcpPerAgent.text.defaultMessage: In an agent's settings, MCP servers: Only these gives it just the servers it needs, such as a sandbox server for a release tester, and keeps the others' tools out of its context.
tips.mcpPerAgent.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.mcpPerAgent.title.defaultMessage: MCP servers for some agents only

tips.mcpPerProject.text.defaultMessage: A workspace MCP server runs in a project only when it's on in the workspace (its switch in the MCP view, which asks for the projects) and on in that project's MCP tab. Its tools stay out of the other projects' agents' context.
tips.mcpPerProject.text.description: A tip. The MCP tab and the MCP view are names in Hive: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.mcpPerProject.title.defaultMessage: MCP servers only where they are needed

tips.memorySnapshot.text.defaultMessage: Turn on Settings → Advanced → Save a memory snapshot if Hive is about to run out of memory, to find out what filled it. Snapshots can be gigabytes, hold what Hive had in memory (card text, transcripts, possibly tokens) and stay on this PC.
tips.memorySnapshot.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.memorySnapshot.title.defaultMessage: Hive closed running out of memory?

tips.mergeBranch.text.defaultMessage: ⑂ beside a branch in Version Control → Branches & remotes merges it into the branch you pick, one merge at a time. A card's branch that isn't Done asks first, and the card is marked merged outside the rules.
tips.mergeBranch.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them. Glossary: outside the rules.

tips.mergeBranch.title.description: A tip's title (#1450): merging any branch outside cards.

tips.mergeQueueFolder.text.defaultMessage: When the merge queue merges into a branch checked out in a folder (main in the project folder), it updates the folder too, but pauses rather than touch a file you are changing. Settings → Advanced can have it ask you under For you first.
tips.mergeQueueFolder.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them. For you is the board's list of what waits for the user.

tips.mergeQueueFolder.title.defaultMessage: Merging into the folder you work in
tips.mergeQueueFolder.title.description: A tip's title: the merge queue merging into a branch (main) that is checked out in the project folder.

tips.mergeQueuePanel.text.defaultMessage: The Progress panel's Merges tab shows each merge queue: the card it is testing and how long its checks usually take, the cards waiting, and a card it returned until you've seen it. Pause queue and Resume queue are there too.
tips.mergeQueuePanel.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them. Glossary 2.5: merge queue, Pause queue / Resume queue; 2.4: returned.

tips.mergeSlot.text.defaultMessage: When several agents finish at once, each claims the project's merge slot before it merges main in, checks and merges, so nobody's checks have to run twice. Who holds it and who waits shows in the Overview and the Progress panel.
tips.mergeSlot.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.mergeStrict.text.defaultMessage: With Hive merging, Version Control → Workflow can have work up to date with its target before it merges: the merge queue updates a card in its own folder, never on the builder’s branch, and the review still counts if it’s the same change.
tips.mergeStrict.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them. Glossary: merge queue, builder, review.

tips.mergeStrict.title.defaultMessage: Work up to date before it merges
tips.mergeStrict.title.description: A tip's title: the workflow option that has Hive's merge queue bring a card's work up to date with its target branch first (G8, strict).

tips.messageReceipts.text.defaultMessage: Every message the Assistant leaves an agent has an id and is kept, even across a restart: it is received once the agent reads its inbox, and acked once the agent acted on it. One not acked within {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} shows as overdue (✉) in its pane.
tips.messageReceipts.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them. {minutes} is how long before a message shows as overdue (30).

tips.messageReceipts.title.defaultMessage: See where a message got to

tips.modelFallbacks.text.defaultMessage: Hive asks Claude Code and Codex which models they have and which effort levels each takes. If a CLI can't say, the model, effort and price lists on its Settings page are yours to edit.
tips.modelFallbacks.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.modelFallbacks.title.defaultMessage: New models without a Hive update

tips.modes.text.defaultMessage: Coordinator runs the agents, Planner shapes work, QA triager turns reports into cards, Release manager takes a release through its checklist. Switch mode from the panel at once, keeping the conversation, or write your own.
tips.modes.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.moreAgents.text.defaultMessage: Need more than {usual, plural, one {# agent} other {# agents}} in a project? Raise Agents per project in Settings → Advanced, up to {most, number}, for every workspace or just this one. Above {usual, number} it shows what they cost on your computer: the memory your running agents take, and how much is free.
tips.moreAgents.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them. {usual} is how many agents a project can have by default (12), {most} the most it can be raised to (24).

tips.moreAgents.title.defaultMessage: More than {usual, plural, one {# agent} other {# agents}}
tips.moreAgents.title.description: A tip's title. {usual} is how many agents a project can have by default (12).

tips.moveAnyway.text.defaultMessage: Dragging a card past a rule of its project (to Done before its review, say) asks first and names the rules it skips. Move Anyway records an override on the card, with your reason: an open lock on its tile says who, which rules and why.
tips.moveAnyway.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them. Glossary: rule, override, Move anyway.

tips.moveAnyway.title.defaultMessage: Move a card past its rules, with a reason

tips.myPrices.text.defaultMessage: Claude Code's cost is its own figure, from its price table. On other rates (a discount, another tier)? Set Session costs to My prices, and Hive prices every session from your table instead.
tips.myPrices.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.myPrices.title.defaultMessage: Your own prices for Claude Code

tips.newCard.text.defaultMessage: Press {key} for a new card for the project you are in, without leaving what you are doing.
tips.newCard.text.description: A tip. {key} is a shortcut (its keys, or the command's name when it has none). Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.noCodeCards.text.defaultMessage: A decision, a write-up or a trial has nothing to commit: tick No code in the New Card dialog. Its work is submitted with a summary and goes to Done with nothing to merge.
tips.noCodeCards.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them. Glossary: no-code card.

tips.off.message.defaultMessage: Help → Tips… still has them, and Settings → General turns them back on.
tips.off.message.description: More in the notice after the tips were turned off. Help → Tips… and Settings → General are names in Hive: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.off.title.description: A notice after "Don't show tips" on the tip card.

tips.overview.text.defaultMessage: The Workspace Overview shows what every project used, what runs now and the board, by day. {key}
tips.overview.text.description: A tip. {key} is a shortcut (its keys, or the command's name when it has none). Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.overview.title.defaultMessage: The whole workspace at a glance

tips.ownShortcuts.text.defaultMessage: Settings → Keyboard Shortcuts changes any shortcut, and Project Settings can change them for one project.
tips.ownShortcuts.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.palette.text.defaultMessage: Press {key} and type: every command, with its shortcut.
tips.palette.text.description: A tip. {key} is a shortcut (its keys, or the command's name when it has none). Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.palette.title.defaultMessage: Everything is in the command palette

tips.paneCells.text.defaultMessage: Drag a pane by its header onto an empty pane to move it there, or onto another to swap them. Each layout keeps where you put them, so switching layouts and back restores it.
tips.paneCells.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.paneCells.title.defaultMessage: Put an agent in any pane

tips.pasteScreenshot.text.defaultMessage: Press Ctrl+V in an agent's terminal with an image on the clipboard, or drop an image onto it: the agent sees it, and Hive keeps a copy.
tips.pasteScreenshot.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.pasteScreenshot.title.defaultMessage: Paste a screenshot into a session

tips.perfCompare.text.defaultMessage: Performance → Compare: keep the current view before a change and again after it, and see whether Hive’s traffic fell while the work still got done.
tips.perfCompare.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.performance.text.defaultMessage: Performance, in the activity bar, shows what Hive's API, tools and guidance cost for the last day, week or month: the whole workspace or one project. Each project has its own Performance tab too.
tips.performance.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.permissionMode.text.defaultMessage: Click the mode in an agent's footer, or press {key}, to move between asking first, accepting edits and planning.
tips.permissionMode.text.description: A tip. {key} is a shortcut (its keys, or the command's name when it has none). Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.progressCard.text.defaultMessage: A run in the Progress panel shows the card and the revision it ran on under the agent, such as #1061 · a3f2c1d: click the card to open it, or the revision to copy it.
tips.progressCard.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them. #1061 is a card's number and a3f2c1d a commit's short id: keep them as they are.

tips.progressCard.title.defaultMessage: Which card was that run for?

tips.progressCheck.text.defaultMessage: A run for a card is recorded as a check of the card's revision. Its details in the Progress panel say Counts as check, or why not: it wasn't started as the check, the folder had uncommitted changes, or files changed while it ran.
tips.progressCheck.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them. "Counts as check" is how a run's details say it counts: keep it as the details do.

tips.progressCheck.title.defaultMessage: Did that run count as a check?

tips.progressCommand.text.defaultMessage: Agents run long commands such as tests and builds through hive-progress, so the Progress panel shows them under the agent's name, with about how long is left from the second time. Settings can have them do it only when you ask.
tips.progressCommand.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.progressDetails.text.defaultMessage: Click a run in the Progress panel, or one under Recent, for its details: the whole command, when it ran and how long it took, its exit code, the log it wrote and why it failed.
tips.progressDetails.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.progressFilter.text.defaultMessage: When several projects run tests and builds, the dropdown at the top of the Progress panel shows just one project's runs, or one agent's. Each workspace remembers the choice.
tips.progressFilter.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.progressHistory.text.defaultMessage: The Runs tab of the Progress panel keeps the last {kept, plural, one {# run} other {# runs}}, even after Hive restarts: by day, a run and its retries in one line. Find them by their words, or show only failures, a lane’s or an agent’s.
tips.progressHistory.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them (Runs: the Progress panel's tab of runs). {kept} is how many runs Hive keeps (200).

tips.progressLanes.text.defaultMessage: When pairs of agents work through cards, the bottom of the Progress panel shows each lane as a bar, a segment per card coloured by where it is. Hover one for its card and round; click to open it. A merge going on shows as a teal card at the top.
tips.progressLanes.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.progressLanes.title.defaultMessage: How far along is each pair?

tips.progressLanesHeight.text.defaultMessage: The Progress panel shows up to four lanes. Drag the line above Lanes up to see more, a whole lane at a time; double-click it to go back to four. Each workspace remembers it.
tips.progressLanesHeight.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.progressLanesOrder.text.defaultMessage: Drag a running lane up or down in the Progress panel, or focus it and press Alt+Up or Alt+Down. Each workspace keeps your order; a new lane comes in on top, and merged ones drop to the bottom.
tips.progressLanesOrder.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.progressPanel.text.defaultMessage: When agents run tests or builds that report progress, the Progress panel on the right shows each run: the agent, how far along it is and the time left, and Hive's taskbar button fills as they go. {key} shows it.
tips.progressPanel.text.description: A tip. {key} is a shortcut (its keys, or the command's name when it has none). Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.progressPanel.title.defaultMessage: How long until the tests finish?

tips.progressTabs.text.defaultMessage: The Progress panel has four tabs: Pulse for what is going on now, then Merges, Runs and Lanes. A red number on Runs counts the runs that failed with nothing passing since; Pulse has a line for them too.
tips.progressTabs.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them (the tabs: Pulse, Merges, Runs, Lanes).

tips.progressTabs.title.description: A tip's title: the Progress panel's tabs, named as the panel shows them.

tips.projectCards.text.defaultMessage: A project's Overview starts with its cards: how many are in each column, stalled or blocked. Click a number to open its Tasks tab.
tips.projectCards.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.projectCards.title.defaultMessage: A project's cards at a glance

tips.projectKeys.text.defaultMessage: Each project has a key of 2 to 4 letters that names its cards: AM-12. Search the board or the command palette for AM-12, or AM- for all of that project’s cards; an old #12 still works. Change a key in Project Settings.
tips.projectKeys.text.description: A tip. AM-12 and AM- are examples of a card's name and a project's key: keep them as they are. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands (Project Settings): keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.projectKeys.title.defaultMessage: Cards are named by their project’s key
tips.projectKeys.title.description: A tip's title. A key is 2–4 letters, such as AM, that a project's cards are named by (AM-12).

tips.projectTabs.text.defaultMessage: When space is short, a project's tabs shrink to icons, and the tab you're on keeps its name while it fits. Hover a tab for its name and shortcut.
tips.projectTabs.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.projectTabsKeys.text.defaultMessage: Alt+1 to Alt+8 open a project's tabs in the order they show, Session to Git. Memory, Skills, Templates and MCP are in More ▾ at the end, and in the menu bar's Project menu.
tips.projectTabsKeys.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them. More ▾ is the button's name with its arrow.

tips.projectTabsKeys.title.defaultMessage: Alt and a number for each tab

tips.quitWhenDone.text.defaultMessage: Quitting while an agent works offers Quit when agents finish: Hive hides and quits by itself once they're done. Conversations are always kept.
tips.quitWhenDone.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.recentWorkspaces.text.defaultMessage: Remove a workspace from File → Open Recent or the welcome page with its ✕, or right-click it. Clear Recently Opened forgets them all; folders that are gone show as not found.
tips.recentWorkspaces.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.removeAll.text.defaultMessage: Remove All in the project header removes all of a project's agents after one question. Worktrees are kept unless you tick the box, which deletes only merged, clean ones.
tips.removeAll.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.resumeAll.text.defaultMessage: After a restart, Resume All Agents in the project header resumes every stopped agent's last session in one go.
tips.resumeAll.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.reviewCopies.text.defaultMessage: A reviewer reviews in a review copy: a folder at exactly the submitted revision, which nothing else writes, so the builder can carry on meanwhile. Its checks there count for that submission. Settings → Advanced turns it off.
tips.reviewCopies.text.description: A tip. A review copy: a folder Hive keeps at exactly the revision under review. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.reviewCopies.title.defaultMessage: Reviewers test exactly what was submitted

tips.reviewerPool.text.defaultMessage: With the workflow option Reviewers set to A shared pool, Start Lane offers the reviewer pool: each card submitted goes to the next free reviewer, oldest first, never to its own builder.
tips.reviewerPool.text.description: A tip. Reviewers and A shared pool are a workflow option and its value; Start Lane is a dialog: keep them as Hive shows them. Glossary: reviewer pool, builder.

tips.reviewerPool.title.description: A tip's title. A lane is Hive's record of a card loop (glossary 2.5: lane).

tips.safeguardStops.text.defaultMessage: A shield beside an agent's status means its CLI's safety classifier stopped a response: hover it for when, the model, and the agent's last tool calls before it. Orange means its model changed since, or it waits on you.
tips.safeguardStops.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.safeguardStops.title.defaultMessage: See when a safety classifier stops an agent

tips.saveTemplate.text.defaultMessage: Set agents up once and reuse them: + Add ▾ → Templates → Save Template… in the session toolbar keeps their settings, roles and layout, and the same menu loads them into any project.
tips.saveTemplate.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.saveTemplate.title.defaultMessage: Save your agents as a template

tips.searchClear.text.defaultMessage: Every search and filter box has an × while it has text: click it, or press Escape, to see everything again. In a dialog or the palette, the next Escape closes it.
tips.searchClear.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.searchClear.title.defaultMessage: Clear a search in one go

tips.searchTranscripts.text.defaultMessage: The Sessions tab searches every session's name, date and transcript (Ctrl+F there): the tree keeps what matches, and a hit opens the conversation at that message.
tips.searchTranscripts.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.sessionCleanup.text.defaultMessage: The Sessions tab's Clean Up Old Sessions… button archives or deletes every session last active more than {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}, {week, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} or {month, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} ago. Running sessions and the one you're reading are left alone.
tips.sessionCleanup.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them. {hours}, {week} and {month} are its choices of age (24 hours, 7 days and 30 days).

tips.sessionSizes.text.defaultMessage: The Sessions tab shows each session's transcript size. One in amber is past Warn when a transcript is over: hand its work over to a new conversation to keep things quick.
tips.sessionSizes.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.sessionSizes.title.defaultMessage: Spot the conversations that grew too long

tips.sessionToolbar.text.defaultMessage: The chip above the panes counts your agents by state; its ▾ lists them, most urgent first: choose one to go to it. Panes | Tiles beside it switches between the agents' terminals and a small tile each.
tips.sessionToolbar.text.description: A tip. Panes and Tiles: the toggle's words, as Hive shows them.

tips.sessionToolbar.title.defaultMessage: Jump to any agent, or see them all as tiles

tips.sessionTree.text.defaultMessage: In the Sessions tab, right-click a provider, an agent or a session with sub-sessions to archive or delete everything in it at once. Running sessions and ones in use are skipped, and Hive says which.
tips.sessionTree.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.sessionTree.title.defaultMessage: Clear out a whole branch of sessions

tips.shareTemplates.text.defaultMessage: The Templates view (activity bar) and a project's Templates tab list every template. Export… saves one as a file for teammates; Import… brings one in, for the workspace or a project.
tips.shareTemplates.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.sharedNotes.text.defaultMessage: Shared notes and handovers live in the workspace, so every project's agents can read them with Hive's tools.
tips.sharedNotes.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.signInExpired.text.defaultMessage: If Claude Code's or Codex's sign-in expires, its agents show Needs sign-in (a violet dot) and you're told once. Sign in again, then Resume All Agents in the project header carries on the ones that stopped.
tips.signInExpired.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.silentUnknown.text.defaultMessage: Hive never guesses an agent is idle: when its turn has been silent for a while with no sign of its end, its pane says so. If its terminal waits at its prompt, Mark idle puts it right.
tips.silentUnknown.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.silentUnknown.title.defaultMessage: An agent silent with its state unknown

tips.skillsDelivered.text.defaultMessage: The switch beside each Hive skill, in the Skills view or a project's Skills tab, says whether agents get it (Delivered to agents). Copies Hive puts in a folder for Codex and Copilot are removed once no agent works there, as Settings → Advanced says.
tips.skillsDelivered.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them. Codex and Copilot are CLIs' names.

tips.slotHeld.text.defaultMessage: When Hive can't tell that everything an agent's session started in a slot has ended, it keeps the slot for it rather than guess. Release Slot… in the agent's ⋯ menu shows what Hive knows, ends what it lists if you want, and frees the slot.
tips.slotHeld.text.description: A tip. A slot: a folder Hive lends to a card or a lane. Release Slot… is a menu item: keep it as Hive shows it; ⋯ is the agent's menu button.

tips.slotHeld.title.defaultMessage: Free a slot held after Hive closed
tips.slotHeld.title.description: A tip's title (#1506). A slot: a folder Hive lends to a card or a lane.

tips.slotOptions.text.defaultMessage: Version Control → Workflow → Slots and copies holds the script run in a new slot, the files copied into it and the slots in use, and how many review copies the project keeps. They save as you change them.
tips.slotOptions.text.description: A tip. A slot: a folder Hive lends to a card or a lane; a review copy: a folder at exactly the revision a reviewer reviews. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.slotOptions.title.defaultMessage: Set up slots in Version Control
tips.slotOptions.title.description: A tip's title. A slot: a folder Hive lends to a card or a lane.

tips.slotResume.text.defaultMessage: A builder's conversation stays in its card's slot. Once the card ends, Resume All leaves it so the slot stays free for new work; its own Resume takes the slot back while nothing else has used it.
tips.slotResume.text.description: A tip. A slot is a worktree Hive lends to a card. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.slotResume.title.defaultMessage: A conversation resumes where it was made

tips.slots.text.defaultMessage: With Where cards are built set to Each card in its own folder, starting a card lends its builder a slot, a ready worktree, and makes the card's branch there. A lane keeps its slot from card to card; with every slot in use, it waits for one.
tips.slots.text.description: A tip. A slot is a working folder (a worktree) Hive lends to a card or a lane. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands (Where cards are built is a workflow option, Each card in its own folder its value; glossary 2.6, G11): keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.slots.title.defaultMessage: Each card on a branch of its own
tips.slots.title.description: A tip's title. A slot is a working folder (a worktree) Hive lends to a card or a lane.

tips.slotsAdopted.text.defaultMessage: Since the upgrade, each builder's own worktree is a slot kept for it until its next card or lane takes it over. Release Slot… in the agent's ⋯ menu gives one up; once free, Hive renames its folder to a slot name, taking its conversations with it.
tips.slotsAdopted.text.description: A tip. A slot is a working folder (a worktree) Hive lends to a card or a lane. Release Slot… is a menu item: keep it as Hive shows it; ⋯ is the agent's menu button.

tips.slotsAdopted.title.defaultMessage: Your agents' worktrees are slots now
tips.slotsAdopted.title.description: A tip's title, after upgrading from Hive 0.9. A slot is a working folder (a worktree) Hive lends to a card or a lane.

tips.sortTables.text.defaultMessage: Click a column's header in Hive's tables (shortcuts, Performance, Storage, the Overviews) to sort by it, again for the other way. Hive remembers each table's sort and rows per page.
tips.sortTables.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.staleMessages.text.defaultMessage: When the Assistant relays something about a card's current round, it ties the message to that card: if the card passes or starts another round before the agent reads it, Hive drops it as stale, so no agent reopens a passed card for an old finding.
tips.staleMessages.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.staleMessages.title.defaultMessage: A message about a round goes stale, not late

tips.startFreshIdle.text.defaultMessage: Long conversations cost more. Start Fresh (Idle Agents) in the project header's Agents menu gives every idle agent a new one in one step, and Hive suggests it when a project's work has finished.
tips.startFreshIdle.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.startFreshIdle.title.defaultMessage: Start idle agents fresh when work is done
