tips.startNewAll.text.defaultMessage: Start New in the project header's Agents menu gives every agent a new session after one question; Archive and Start New archives their old ones first. Their conversations stay in the Sessions tab.
tips.startNewAll.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.storageCleanup.text.defaultMessage: Project Settings → Storage shows how much space a project's backups, archive, attachments and worktrees take. Clean Up… moves old attachments and backups to the Recycle Bin, and shows you exactly what goes first.
tips.storageCleanup.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.storageCleanup.title.defaultMessage: See what Hive keeps, and clean up

tips.storagePurge.text.defaultMessage: Purge… in Project Settings → Storage, or Purge Hive's Files… on a session, removes everything Hive keeps for sessions: backups, attachments and leftovers. It lists every file first; the coding agents' own files and your usage totals stay.
tips.storagePurge.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.taskbarBadge.text.defaultMessage: Hive's taskbar button shows how many agents need you, and flashes when one asks you something while Hive is in the background.
tips.taskbarBadge.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.teamPreset.text.defaultMessage: Team, in Version Control → Workflow, is Pair with stricter checks: the unit tests pass before review and on the merged result, dependencies are installed from scratch before every merge, and cards labelled ui or release wait for your OK.
tips.teamPreset.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them (glossary 2.1: Team, Pair).

tips.teamPreset.title.defaultMessage: Several builders? Try the Team preset

tips.teamTemplates.text.defaultMessage: The Templates view’s Hive group has ready-made teams: Solo, Pair, Pair: one provider, Team 3×3, Team 6×6 and Team 6 + pool, with builders and reviewers paired. Loading one offers to switch the project to the preset it suits.
tips.teamTemplates.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands, and of Hive's own templates: keep them as Hive shows them. Glossary: builder, reviewer, preset.

tips.teamTemplates.title.defaultMessage: Start from one of Hive’s templates

tips.templateNames.text.defaultMessage: Agent names are unique across the workspace. Loading a template from another project, give its agents new names in the list beside the template's own: Load template waits until none is taken.
tips.templateNames.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.templateNames.title.defaultMessage: Name a template's agents as you load it

tips.testedClis.text.defaultMessage: Claude Code, Codex and Copilot update on their own. Agent Setup shows the version this Hive release was tested with next to the one you have, and says when yours is newer or older.
tips.testedClis.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.testedClis.title.defaultMessage: See which CLI versions Hive was tested with

tips.tileStrip.text.defaultMessage: In an agent's focus view (Tiles), the strip on the left shows each agent's card as a small chip, tinted with the colour of the board column it is in; click one to open the card. Drag the strip's edge to make it wider, and double-click the edge to reset it.
tips.tileStrip.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands (Tiles): keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.tileStrip.title.defaultMessage: Each agent's card, beside its name

tips.tileStripOrder.text.defaultMessage: In an agent's focus view (Tiles), drag an agent up or down the strip on the left, or press Alt+Up or Alt+Down on it. The tiles and the panes follow the same order.
tips.tileStripOrder.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands (Tiles): keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.tileStripOrder.title.defaultMessage: Reorder agents from the focus view

tips.tilesView.text.defaultMessage: Tiles shows each agent as a small tile: its state, status, card, progress and latest reply, twelve to a page. Click one to open its pane large beside the others; Esc goes back. Settings → Sessions → Tile order can put the agents waiting for you first.
tips.tilesView.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands (Tiles, Tile order): keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.tilesView.title.defaultMessage: See a whole team at once as tiles

tips.triageReport.text.defaultMessage: Tell the Assistant in QA triager mode what you did and saw, or paste a screenshot. It finds the cause in the code, checks for a card that already covers it (even one not merged yet), then files a card with the evidence.
tips.triageReport.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.triageReport.title.defaultMessage: Report a problem to the QA triager
tips.triageReport.title.description: A tip's title. QA triager is a mode of the Hive Assistant: keep its name as Hive shows it.

tips.twoProviders.text.defaultMessage: Agents in one project can use different providers: say a Codex reviewer next to a Claude Code agent. Hand Over to… passes work between them.
tips.twoProviders.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.ui.close.description: Closes the tip card or Help → Tips.

tips.ui.counter.defaultMessage: {total, plural, one {Tip · {n, number} of #} other {Tip · {n, number} of #}}
tips.ui.counter.description: The tip card's heading: which tip ({n}) of how many ({total}) it is. A plural on {total}, for a language whose words change with it.

tips.ui.learnMore.description: Button on a tip: opens the user guide where it explains it.

tips.ui.next.description: Button on the tip card: shows the next tip.

tips.ui.noMatch.description: Help → Tips when its search finds nothing. {query} is what was typed; use your language's quotation marks.

tips.ui.off.description: A link on the tip card: turns off the tip when Hive starts.

tips.ui.search.description: Placeholder of Help → Tips' search box.

tips.ui.showOnStart.defaultMessage: Show a tip when Hive starts
tips.ui.showOnStart.description: A switch in Help → Tips: shows a tip of the day when Hive starts (the same as Settings → General → Show a tip when Hive starts).

tips.ui.tip.description: The name, for screen readers, of the tip card.

tips.ui.tryIt.description: Button on a tip: runs the command it is about.

tips.unexpectedClose.text.defaultMessage: If Hive was ended without quitting (a crash, or something closed it), the next start says when it was last seen and which agents were running, with Resume All. Settings → Sessions → Resume agents after an unexpected close resumes them by itself.
tips.unexpectedClose.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.unmerged.text.defaultMessage: The agent's tab shows how many commits aren't merged yet, Merge… in its ⋯ menu says what is left, and Version Control → Changes shows everything the agent changed since it branched.
tips.unmerged.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.unmerged.title.defaultMessage: See what a worktree agent has to merge

tips.unusedWorktrees.text.defaultMessage: Removed an agent but kept its worktree? Version Control → Changes opens on the worktrees no agent uses, saying who made each: open one to see its work and merge it, or remove the merged ones with their branches.
tips.unusedWorktrees.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.versionControlSwitch.text.defaultMessage: Click None or Git atop a project’s Version Control tab to switch it from its next card; cards in flight keep the old rules. Each keeps its own workflow options, and when the folder changes (git init, say), Hive offers the switch there.
tips.versionControlSwitch.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them (glossary 2.1: None, Git, Version Control, old rules, workflow). Keep git init as it is (a command).

tips.versionControlTab.text.defaultMessage: A project’s Version Control tab says what Hive found in its folder, and starts with Workflow: who reviews, which checks pass first and who merges. Its header names the preset, and a click on it opens them.
tips.versionControlTab.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them (glossary 2.1: Version Control, Workflow, preset).

tips.versionControlTab.title.defaultMessage: One tab for version control and workflow
tips.versionControlTab.title.description: A tip's title (glossary 2.1: version control, workflow).

tips.viewerTokens.text.defaultMessage: An app that shows what your agents are doing, such as Apiary, needs only a viewer token: Settings → Agent API → Viewer tokens makes one that can read everything and change nothing, and revokes it again.
tips.viewerTokens.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.workflowDefaults.text.defaultMessage: Settings → Workflow defaults sets the options every project starts from, and Settings → Workspace the open workspace’s. A project’s own options still win, and saving lists the projects that inherit the change.
tips.workflowDefaults.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them (glossary 2.1: workflow).

tips.workflowDefaults.title.defaultMessage: Set a workflow once for every project

tips.workflowOptions.text.defaultMessage: Version Control → Workflow sets who reviews a card’s work, which checks pass first and who merges it. Pick a preset, or set each option: a change applies from the next card that starts.
tips.workflowOptions.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.workflowOptions.title.defaultMessage: Choose how cards get to Done

tips.workflowPresetsWhy.text.defaultMessage: In Version Control → Workflow, click Solo, Pair or Team: it lists each option it sets and why, and marks what it would change. Nothing changes until you use it and save.
tips.workflowPresetsWhy.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them (glossary 2.1: Solo, Pair, Team).

tips.workflowPresetsWhy.title.defaultMessage: See what a preset does before you use it

tips.workspaceMoved.text.defaultMessage: Moved the workspace folder, say to another drive? Open it from its new place and choose Repair… in the banner: agents' worktrees, their sessions, and Claude Code's conversations and memory follow it.
tips.workspaceMoved.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.workspaceMoved.title.defaultMessage: Move a workspace without losing its agents

tips.workspaceMovedDefender.text.defaultMessage: If Hive had Defender skip the workspace's folders, Repair… after a move offers to move those exclusions to the new folders, with one administrator prompt, so none is left on a folder that's gone. Exclusions you made yourself stay as they are.
tips.workspaceMovedDefender.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them.

tips.workspaceMovedDefender.title.defaultMessage: Defender exclusions follow a moved workspace

tips.workspaceNotes.text.defaultMessage: Workspace notes, pinned first in Shared Notes, is for what's true of this machine, like a full path. Every agent gets it when it starts, in any folder, so it needn't go in a committed AGENTS.md. A section headed with a project's name is that project's alone.
tips.workspaceNotes.text.description: A tip. Names of Hive's menus, views, settings and commands: keep them as Hive shows them. Workspace notes is a shared note's name and AGENTS.md a file name: keep both in English.

tips.workspaceNotes.title.defaultMessage: Notes about this machine for every agent
